title: Clue, Revelation, Mystery & Investigation Design
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Clue, Revelation, Mystery and Investigation Design over the MAS-01..05 foundations, using explicit owner-domain and prepared Quest/route references while preserving canonical Investigation, Knowledge and runtime authority and ensuring prepared clues or revelations never prove discovery or reveal state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared clue, revelation, mystery and investigation design inside the MAS workspace without duplicating canonical Investigation/Knowledge/runtime state or treating authored/reachable information as discovered or revealed live truth.
included: explicit owner and MAS-05 Quest/Objective/Task references
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author clues, revelations, mysteries and investigations over prepared MAS-01..05 material with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states, while preserving canonical Investigation/Knowledge/runtime authority and never treating prepared clues or revelations as discovered, revealed or resolved live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 workspace/document authority, MAS-02 higher-order structure, MAS-03 prepared assembly, MAS-04 prepared nonlinear graph and MAS-05 prepared Quest authoring remain foundational and were not reopened.

Clue, Revelation, Mystery and Investigation structures are prepared MAS authoring semantics only; canonical Investigation and Knowledge/KFR owner domains retain discovery, reveal, understanding, resolution and mutation authority.

Prepared clues and revelations never become live discovery/reveal truth; discovered clues, revealed revelations, understood knowledge, resolved mysteries and resolved investigation plans remain explicitly empty in the prepared projection.
MAS-06 consumes validated Investigation/Knowledge bindings plus MAS-04 route and MAS-05 Quest/Objective/Task references; unresolved references fail closed.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-06.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-06, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-07 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-08+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-06 is closed. MAS-07 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
